rfam.comment: SAM-V riboswitch is a cis-regulatory element that was recognised in marine bacteria [1,2] it recognise S-adenosylmethione (SAM). The binding of SAM leads to the association of the triplex third strand in the aptamer of SAM-V riboswitch that stabilizes a short helix and occludes the ribosome binding site. SAM-V riboswitch structure was reported in PDB:6FZ0 [3].
